name: LD39015M33R
title: LD39015: fixed-output 150 mA LDO, 18 µA ground current, no noise-bypass pin
summary: A fixed-output linear regulator in SOT23-5L that runs from 1.5 V to 5.5 V and delivers up to 150 mA, dropping about 80 mV at 100 mA. Ground current is 18 µA with no load and stays under 1 µA when EN is pulled low. It is stable with 1 µF ceramic capacitors, has no noise-bypass pin, and limits its own current and junction temperature. Eight output voltages from 0.8 V to 3.3 V are listed as order codes.

circuits.title: Typical application
circuits.description: One 1 µF capacitor from IN to ground, one 1 µF capacitor from OUT to ground, and the load across the output. EN is driven from its own input, VEN.

operation.text: A 1.22 V bandgap with a trimming block sets the reference for an error amplifier. The amplifier compares it with a divider (R1 over R2) from OUT to GND and, through a driver transistor, controls the pass transistor between IN and OUT. A thermal-protection block and the enable block both act on the amplifier. A capacitor runs from OUT to the feedback node.

EN reads as high at 0.9 V or more and as low at 0.4 V or less over the full input and temperature range. Its input current is 0.1 nA typical, 100 nA at most. With EN low the part draws 0.001 µA typical, 1 µA at most. EN may go up to VI + 0.3 V. After EN rises, the output reaches 95 % of nominal in about 30 µs.
The regulator turns on once the input rises past 1.45 V typical (1.48 V at most) and turns off when it falls to 1.35 V typical (1.30 V at least).
The output current is limited to a constant value: into a dead short it delivers about 350 mA. Thermal shutdown acts at about 160 °C with 20 °C of hysteresis.

The part is stable with ceramic capacitors. The output takes 1 µF to 22 µF; the stability graph bounds ESR, measured at 100 kHz, between a few tens of milliohms and about 2 Ω across that range. The electrical characteristics are given with CIN = COUT = 1 µF.

The output is fixed by order code. Parts set below 1.2 V are characterized at 1.5 V in; the others at VOUT + 1 V. The dropout figure is only given for outputs above 1.5 V. Accuracy is a percentage for outputs above 1.5 V and a fixed ±10 mV (±30 mV over temperature, typical) below.
There is no bypass pin; the 0.8 V part gives 29 µVRMS from 1.1 kHz to 100 kHz. Ripple rejection is about 65 dB at low frequency, begins to roll off near 10 kHz and reaches roughly 35 dB at 100 kHz.
In SOT23-5L the junction-to-ambient resistance is 255 °C/W and junction-to-case is 81 °C/W. The junction may run from -40 °C to 125 °C.
